DelphiR: Statistical Analysis of Delphi Studies

Source: R/DelphiR-package.R
DelphiR-package.Rd

DelphiR imports, validates and summarises the ratings collected in a Delphi study.

The DelphiR data format

Input data follow a wide layout: one row per expert, one column per item, and one numeric rating in each cell. Three optional columns describe the context of the rows:

  • an expert column with a stable identifier, needed to follow the same expert across rounds;

  • a round column (1, 2, 3, ...);

  • an indicator column naming what was rated, for example "impact" or "plausibility".

When the round or the indicator column is absent, the whole table is treated as a single round or a single indicator, given by the round and indicator arguments of delphi_data(). Tables for different rounds or indicators can also be imported separately and combined with delphi_bind().

Each indicator has its own rating scale (for example from 1 to 10 or from 1 to 100), which is used to validate the ratings and to compare dispersion across scales.

Ratings can also be supplied in long format, with one row per rating (delphi_data_long()), or read from survey exports with two header rows (read_delphi()). delphi_template() creates an empty file in the required format. When expert identifiers do not denote the same person in every round, the data should be declared as not linked (linked = FALSE).

Main functions

  • delphi_template(): data-entry template.

  • read_delphi(), delphi_data() and delphi_data_long(): import and validation.

  • delphi_bind(): combine rounds or indicators.

  • delphi_describe(): descriptive statistics by item, round and indicator.

  • delphi_panel(): respondents and retention across rounds.

  • delphi_consensus(): IQR consensus rule (IQR at most 20% of the scale by default).

  • delphi_stability(): stability between rounds (Wilcoxon test or Scheibe 15% criterion).

  • delphi_status(): consensus and stability together, and the items for the next round.

  • delphi_plot_distribution(), delphi_plot_trend(), delphi_plot_consensus() and delphi_plot_map(), or plot(): publication-quality figures built with ggplot2.

  • delphi_report(): a self-contained round report in HTML or Word format.

  • delphi_wide() and as.data.frame(): back to wide or long tables.

See vignette("DelphiR") for an introduction to the complete workflow.
